title: kbmon's sessions panel keys worktrees by directory name, so a same-named worktree shows as the clone
goal: the sessions panel names each worktree by its own path, so two checkouts that share a directory name keep separate rows and a process in the clone keeps its branch

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import mon_sessions as m
n=m.display_names('/x/a/wt',['/x/a/wt','/x/b/wt'])
print(n);sys.exit(1 if len(n)<2 else 0)
